method: For every transition of both sound-positive finite models, construct synthetic Claim/Provenance/MemoryState and an empty ChangeSet.
Realize the arbitrary baseline trigger using known_incomplete on synthetic provenance only; preserve ordinary previously_unavailable handling.
Map model age to last_checked_commit in a finite unique revision sequence and invoke the real PeriodicAudit adapter.
For each withheld predecessor use both contradicted/stale and insufficient/needs_validation metadata; available predecessors use supported/valid metadata.

Invoke actual cami.policies.advance_state with the modeled validation result or None. Verify selection, reasons, availability, derived age, revision, last verdict, last checked/supported and state/basis.
Every validation result is a modeled input, not an executed probe or independent truth label.
negative_controls: Suppress periodic selection at the deadline.
After an inconclusive selected validation, preserve old availability.
limits: Bounded correspondence check for K=1,2,4,8 and canonical states, not a proof of all production histories.
Synthetic revision identifiers; no Git or Docker execution in this check.
Production selector/state functions are exercised but runtime environment, crash consistency and validator correctness are outside scope.
No real provenance, parent/child labels, receipts, admission or main protocol changes.
